_note: Per-task spec. Fill from the brief and config.yaml defaults, show the user, get it confirmed. After that, never loosen a threshold to pass a check; ask instead. Paths are relative to the folder holding this file (task/).

mesh._split_ratio: max_split_vertex_ratio (exported/raw verts) only for smooth props, e.g. 2.0; flat-shaded hard-surface props are 3+ by nature

camera._fixed_camera: First render_rig run solves distance_m/look_at (calibration mode, px checks are info). Copy them here: distance_m, look_at.

_iou_coverage: Optional: add "iou" and "coverage" blocks only when the scene has a ConceptCam matching a perspective concept (see templates/spec.example.rock-moss.json). Orthographic concept IoU comes from assembly/gate1/measure.

export.expect_unlit: true for hand_painted, false for pbr
